exitStatusSource: Raw final log contains no exit field. Earlier source run exit1 is manager-reported; retain final execution status from manager runner separately.

groups.retainedReason: Defines the test boundary: real SDK/provider/session/routes with a fake remote API and substituted destinations. It prevents treating this integration proof as real WorkOS evidence and identifies the live gate that covers that limit.
Explains why billing is deliberately absent from the substitute destinations: the route owns a real billing page. Without this reason, the missing entry looks like a coverage gap.

Gives the compact cross-workspace role matrix behind isolation and permission cases: User here, Admin there, inactive/default elsewhere. The table's purpose spans several fixture records and is useful when checking that a different workspace cannot supply authority.

Defines the remote-request assertion scope. JWKS discovery is excluded from the organization-call trace so key-set traffic is not mistaken for a membership/catalog read. That scope matters when interpreting the new picker-read assertion.
Records the division of authority: route session/current-access admission does not replace each operation's permission check. The local AccountOperation type cannot express that security obligation.
Explains why signed-in failures become pages and why immutable answers are reconstructed: refreshed or ended session cookies must reach the browser on errors too.

Records dispatch precedence: dedicated administration handling must run before the generic account operation fallback. This is a collaboration constraint, not a reason to move authorization into the fallback.
States the changed picker invariant: identity admits the recovery page; optional access controls display only. It prevents a later refactor from turning the display lookup into an admission gate.

Explains origin-before-body order and current-membership authority. A foreign form must cause no body/service work, and the session must switch to the ID confirmed by the service rather than an untrusted request hint.

Explains cookie precedence and response reconstruction. Session-refresh cookies must precede a later switch cookie, including when redirect headers are immutable. The order affects actual browser session state.
Explains directory normalization for relative route paths. The missing final slash would otherwise change URL resolution and public-base containment.
Explains why cloning precedes freezing: later mutations to resolver-owned records must not change a running operation's context, and the route must not freeze the collaborator's own object.

Keeps the dedicated browser gate's shared workspace shell and Members/Audit/Connect/picker viewport and JavaScript matrix discoverable under one entry point. Protocol mechanics already live in drivers, including the new WorkspaceSelectionBrowser. A threshold-only split would scatter the matrix without simplifying source behavior.

One integration subject verifies the real provider/session/account-route collaboration against a pinned local WorkOS API fake. Offered memberships, current permission isolation, exact remote reads and rejected provider data share one role matrix and composition. Keeping them together makes the new optional-read phase comparable to unchanged selection authority.

metricsAndGateLimit: No coverage, image or live pass inferred. Manager reports ordinary5372+51 only; fresh metric/gate evidence is separate.
reviewerActions: Read-only commands and ignored review artifacts only; no hook/build/test/MCP run or tracked edit
applicability: All source/test/config inputs identical by final-head-input-bridge-v3.json; every v3 retained reason and location still applies.
